Evan: Postmortem follow-up: we need owners/timelines for remediation + incident-driven tests (promptset, regression, load smoke, chaos).
Maya: Split into hotfix (72h) vs test work (2-6w). Hotfixes: retry jitter + kv TTL tuning. Tests: incident promptset, regression cases, small load smoke, chaos drill.
Caleb: I can take retry jitter + TTL tuning. Plan: patch -> staged rollout -> 48h monitor. ETA: 2026-04-02.
Maya: I'll own promptset + regression harness. New promptset name: incident-526-synth. 18 targeted prompts including short-repeat cases.
runbot: CI: nightly job scheduled for incident-526-synth at 2026-03-24T04:00:00Z
Evan: Regression harness acceptance: per-prompt expected class + similarity threshold. Gate CI to open an issue on >3 failures.
Caleb: Load smoke plan: 2k concurrent, 5 min ramp, measure P95/P99 and token cost. Need infra approve. Target 2w.
Maya: Chaos drill: partial pod restart + forced KV eviction at steady traffic. Run after regression + load smoke pass. Tentative 2026-04-20.
Evan: I'll create parent ticket REM-526 and link child tasks. Please add PR links and update REM-526 when ready.
Maya: Opening PRs for promptset + CI today (evals#423).
Caleb: Infra PR for TTL+retry (infra#215).
Evan: Thanks. Add runbook steps to the parent ticket and make chaos drill recurring if pattern repeats. :thumbsup:
